problem.smallest_dependency: Introduce genuine public owned-byte whole admission only. PackageSet native tuple/member brands/read/handoff remain separate. Real browser/portable runtime remains separate. No consumer can emulate source identity or mint native snapshots.

module.definition_identity: definition_digest is sha256: followed by lowercase SHA-256 hex of the existing strict canonicalJson UTF-8 encoding of this complete installed public module value. This field states the rule and does not embed a self-referential digest. The original full source identity and the projected product identity are bound separately; matching this module digest does not bind external types, resolved values, schema/API closure or installed package bytes.

scope.supported: Node-only complete Uint8Array/Buffer holding native unprotected public06 ZIP; whole_asset request only. Existing physical member whitelist, known STORE/DEFLATE admission support, ZIP-comment and last matching EOCD semantics, resources/doc2/checksums/kdsig policy all preserved.
scope.excluded: No string/path, URL/network, ArrayBuffer overload, browser-platform export, RangeReader callback, catalog/scoped/expand direct admission, password/external protected payload, old05 interpretation, producer/write/save, PackageSet, action/Read delivery or consumer changes.
scope.existing_routes: Original path sections-node, protected operation reuse, retained-sections-node, execution-sections-node, source/creation and all old exports retain exact meanings. New bytes result is not a relabelled fresh path capture or old05 brand.

input.order: First verify same-instance admitted request and new byte-authority tokens without invoking callback; reject non-whole mode explicitly at input with unsupported / READ_CORE_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE (not asset invalid), then validate byte view and original physical25MiB bound, synchronously copy the full view into Core-exclusive memory before the first await or callback. Do not access input again afterward.
input.owned_bytes: Accept genuine Uint8Array and Buffer only. Detect Proxy before reflection. Use intrinsic typed-array byteLength/byteOffset/buffer/tag, require dense intrinsic indexed byte data and only standard Uint8Array/Buffer prototypes. Enumerate only enumerable own string keys; they must be exactly the intrinsic dense numeric indices with no extra enumerable key. Reject all own symbols, custom prototypes/subclasses and shared/resizable/detached backing stores. Non-enumerable own string properties are outside the byte-view input meaning and are neither enumerated nor read; this includes shadow byteLength/length/buffer/toJSON or other accessors, which never participate in validation/copy and are never invoked. No getter/toJSON/custom iterator invocation is permitted. Preserve exact intrinsic view slice and original physical25MiB cap; synchronously copy before first await/callback. Caller bytes/attributes are never frozen/zeroed/mutated. Caller mutation, resize attempt or release after the synchronous copy cannot affect the operation.
input.no_fabricated_file: The owned byte store has a native random capture_id; never fabricate a filename, inode/stat/FD, same-file lineage, temporary05 file, or file-read ledger. No asset-source fs/open/stat/path operation or temporary-asset-file roundtrip is permitted. This restriction does not prohibit runtime module/dependency loading; those real process filesystem accesses are separately identified in test evidence, not erased by prewarming or reported as asset reads. Original path sameFD race rule stays on that path; here stable-owned-copy is the sufficient input continuity premise.

authorization.factory: createNativeSectionByteReadAuthority snapshots the original closed SectionSignaturePolicy06 (default false/null) and callback in a same-instance WeakMap. JSON/foreign tokens reject. Policy is trusted-caller input; embedded public key is not trust. Pin itself requires signature under original semantics.
authorization.pregrant: Ownership copy necessarily observes every supplied raw byte; it is explicitly counted, not concealed as metadata-only I/O. Possession/copy is not permission for body decoding or disclosure. Only original approved bounded ZIP probes, mimetype and raw Manifest parsing occur before grant; retain bounded ZIP malformed-layout overlap caveat. No pack/table/body inflate/CBOR/domain, optional member materialization, checksum/signature read/verify or A/C/E/IR calculation before literal true grant.
authorization.context: Provide complete readonly NativeSectionByteAuthorityContext06. observation.capture is nonnull and from actual owned metadata; table_frames empty before grant. request_digest equals original admitted whole request, input length/copy range exact, signature_read_intent lists the actual original signature domain from observed directory and original policy. The new operation/input kind explicitly disclose whole in-memory admission. Freeze/copy all context before callback; callback cannot weaken policy/request/capture. Signature policy is not a replacement for this grant.
authorization.denial: Await once per invocation. Only literal true authorizes postgrant processing. False/undefined/thenable result not resolving true and thrown callback all preserve current authorization refusal with null snapshot. Unknown internal exceptions use READ_CORE_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE; do not trust arbitrary callback error.code.
authorization.permission_separation: Technical Core admission has no Host Read permission, action permission, source complete disclosure or author adoption. Each retained Read still requires its own current request authority/Host/scope/budget/delivery; execution still requires separate original action/output authorization.

admission.single_source: After grant run exact existing whole06 container/member/routing/frame/schema/registry/order/domain/Resource/component/static policy/interpretation validation on the same owned bytes. Reuse original semantics and actual checks; no Payload/IR/frame synthesis, no metadata claims replacing observed values, no semantic bypass, no fallback old05. All unknown critical/validation precedence remains exact original whole path.
admission.integrity: Compute actual A exact owned whole bytes, C0.2 original content basis, E0.3 candidate actual manifest+packs+runtime mandatory members and original complete IR digest. Check source declared selfC, actual doc2 member rows/E and original kdsig complete domain (includes optional attachment) under policy exactly as current whole. expected claims never become observations. Present signature is verified even when not required.
admission.brand: Only after complete success issue WholeSectionSnapshot06 in the same exact native sections WeakMap used by inspectWholeSectionSnapshot, retained and execution; no old CanonicalReadSnapshot brand and no copied JSON token. Snapshot actual asset/tuple/full IR/runtime members/WholeVerification06/digests retain existing typed values. It is a new independent capture/snapshot, not equal random identity to another read of same bytes.
admission.proof_mapping: WholeVerification06.capture is the identical actual CapturedInput06, request_digest the admitted whole request; checksum/signature nested receipts refer to this capture and request. Raw Manifest/directory hashes, actual checked table/data/structure evidence from the owned store retain absolute ZIP byte offsets and lengths. Whole fields all verified only after real full checks. NativeSectionByteObservation06 separately declares storage as owned_uint8array; no old field is overwritten to claim path provenance.
admission.reuse: The genuine whole snapshot may feed retained-read and native-execution APIs under their existing independent authorities and immutable-origin rules. A byte origin is not a fresh path origin: bindSectionExpansionRequest refuses it with READ_HANDLE_STALE rather than admitting an unrelated file. Retained expansion uses the immutable snapshot route and actual Host handle registration.
admission.errors: Preserve current supported original code/field/subject and stage for actual data failures; unknown internal exceptions capability. unsupported is reserved for explicit unsupported scope/profiles, not malformed input. Invalid input/foreign request/authority returns rejected input (original code as applicable), null snapshot. Source failures never get a forged partial or whole witness.

accounting.bounds: Keep real physical25MiB, decoded total12MiB, real member8MiB,128 members and every strict object/depth/string/array/graph/overflow guard. No independent decoded logical aggregate8MiB is introduced. Owning bytes adds one explicit physical-sized copy; not a memory/performance improvement claim.
accounting.ledger: NativeSectionByteObservation06.ownership_copy is exactly [0,input_byte_length) for the initial capture, including before denial. access_ranges preserves actual ordered subsequent range accesses with original SectionIORange06 purposes, including duplicates; these are in-memory accesses, never FileHandle I/O. The existing field filesystem_reads=0 counts asset-source file I/O only: no asset path, temporary asset or filesystem source is read. It is not a process-wide zero-filesystem assertion. Actual runtime/module/dependency loading reads must be recorded separately by exact path and purpose in runtime evidence, including first-use lazy loads; do not hide them through prewarming. Capture is null before valid metadata and nonnull when acquired; input_observation null if no owned copy completed. Zero ranges does not mean zero copied bytes.
accounting.budget: Original request budget_bytes remains bound in request_digest; this Core admission neither delivers a Read envelope nor treats that budget as asset/decode/memory limit. Subsequent Read performs original exact complete-envelope budgeting; native execution plan/capsule/output budgets remain separate. No new timeout field/clock contract is invented in this minimal admission surface.
accounting.cleanup: Owned store and parse temporary buffers are operation-local; on failure release references. Success retains only original immutable complete snapshot and minimal origin-kind brand metadata needed for legal inspection/retained/execution; not original caller references, mutable owned raw bytes or authority callbacks. No public dispose semantics are invented for ordinary immutable whole snapshot.

api.existing_inputs: Request is produced by unchanged public sections-node.admitSectionRequest; inspectSectionRequest and inspectWholeSectionSnapshot remain unchanged. Import existing opaque brands, never regenerate parallel nominal brands.
api.read_exports: None new. No modification to old browser Read or PackageSet Read exports.
api.packaging: When later activated, emit only candidate/sectionbytes06 roots and typed closure into a new generated directory, preserve original685 generated products except named new package export/internal same-instance mint helper wiring. Exact old-product deltas listed and independently reviewed; no broad regeneration replacement. CJS/ESM exports same function/brand closure; actual strict CTS/MTS compile on installed package required.

validation_requirements: Old05 controls remain unchanged; real owned native06 whole positive must match independent entire current path IR/value/order/absence/A/C/E except named random capture/snapshot/request-bound receipts.
Actual authored small and rich attachment/lineage/self-C output bytes; ZIP comment/max-comment and last-candidate negative route; STORE/DEFLATE controls.
Caller mutation during grant proves stable owned copy; invalid proxy/getter/subclass/shared/detached/over25 input rejects before grant with no side effects.

Authority deny/throw/foreign/weak pin controls, pregrant actual memoryaccess ledger versus decode/hash stages, zero asset-source path/fs use; separately record actual process module/dependency loading without claiming process-wide zero I/O or concealing lazy reads.
Checksums/signed optionalattachment positives and exact negative classifications; original critical/Resource/component failures retain priority.
True same-instance new whole→retained exact/registeredexpand and nativeplan/capsule positive; action/output deny separate; JSON/foreign/partial/protected negatives.
Exact four physical gates as reachable plus preserved original limits, no unproven object/platform/performance inference.
Node execution does not establish browser support; portable/browser exports and PackageSet mapping require their own closed contracts and runtime evidence.
